main_text.p: Dei beneficio immerentes,inuiti,repugnantes, ad lucis illius admirabilis participationem vocati fumus,& qui hac luce freti videmus myfte-ria Dei in Ecclefia eius expofita, quæ non videt mundus, & fpiritalem fructum ex eis commu-niter ac fingulariter percipimus in Christo Iesu, quanto ftudio, quanta religione, quanta con-tentione pietatis ad hæc omnia recognofcen-da in Domino, in ecclefia,in fratribus noftris, in nobis ipfis opus eft accurrere?qui Ecclefiam nouimus Dei domum effe, qui falutem à Deo in Ecclefia quodammodo depofitam, qui pe-des noftros diuino duétu in ea collocatos, qui eadem virtute pedes ibidem confiftentes om-nium procellarum impetum proculcare, qui nos à Deo Ecclefiaque curari in portis illius quamfideliffimè, qui denique omni benedi-ctioni fpirituali in locis fupercæleftibus in Christo nos locupletatos effe, quo vfque tan-dem operibus noftris & conuerfatione emen-tiemur lucem diuinæ veritatis in noftris men-tibus & confcientiis radiantem? Quin potius Deo, Ecclefiæ, fratribus, & nobis ipfis tribui-uus fingulis quod fuum eft ? Iam plus fatis à Deo auertimus mentes, animos, &officia pie-tatis omnia, quibus nos obftrictos effe iamdiu Deo auctore, reftante verbo ,confcientia fodi-cante nouimus. page.notes: Page number at top left reads "§6" in a decorative form; read as 96, uncertain. Running head is set with letter spacing as "EIRENICI". Marks at the foot of the page (small glyphs near the centre and right) could not be identified and are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "repugnantes" (long s in the printed form), "trophea" (last letter may be Greek alpha), "&officia" and "conscientia" spacing as printed. The line "Iam plus fatis eripiuntur" appears twice in the reading; I have transcribed it as printed.
